description: Capability for the main window. The commands of the app need no permission (the app has no ACL manifest). The UI listens to the events session-changed, floor-changed and employee-started. The UI sets the window title to "(N) Agent Tower" while N sessions ask a question (core:window:allow-set-title). The "Browse..." button opens the system folder dialog (dialog:allow-open). The desktop notification for a question uses the notification plugin (notification:default).
